To make `root>mid>leaf` gain `padding: 40px` on hover, the `:hover` rule has to be applied to the element that’s actually in the `:hover` state. Since the hover target is `root>mid>leaf` (the node the mouse is over), its own CSS block is the one whose `:hover` selector must target that node so the padding changes when it’s hovered.

ANSWER: root>mid>leaf
